question.text: SEBI has prescribed maximum leverage limits for Category III AIFs in relation to Net Asset Value. Per Ch 12 and current SEBI framework, this maximum leverage is:

answer.text: 1x of NAV (i.e., no net leverage beyond equity).
There is no SEBI-prescribed maximum leverage — Managers self-impose.

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that Category III AIF leverage shall not exceed 2 times NAV. Chapter 12 also notes that investors should be aware of the SEBI-prescribed maximum leverage limits applicable to Category III AIFs. The Trap: Option A understates the cap. Option B overstates it. Option D is incorrect because SEBI has prescribed an explicit cap. Note: Leverage is computed in line with SEBI's prescribed methodology for Category III AIFs and is monitored on an ongoing basis.
